task.title: Pull Changes
task.shortdesc: Bring the remote's commits into your local branch, by merging or rebasing.

context.p: Pulling files downloads the remote commits and integrates them into your current branch. You choose how they are integrated. See if you are unsure which to pick.

step.cmd:
On the
toolbar, open the
drop-down and choose how to integrate the changes.

choices.choice: - Creates a merge commit if your branch and the remote have both moved on.
- Replays your local commits on top of the remote ones for a linear history.
- Pulls from a branch other than the one you are tracking.

info.p: The option you choose between and becomes the default action on the toolbar button.

result.p: If the pull produces conflicts, resolve them before continuing. See .
result.note: A pull may need to set your local changes aside before it integrates remote commits. The Git Client can stash those changes internally, but the operation is refused if the working copy has a file system name collision. To manually set aside changes before pulling, see .
